auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.School, T2.MailZip
FROM SchoolInfo AS T1
JOIN MailingInfo AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN AdminInfo AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode
WHERE (T3.AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND T3.AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (T3.AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND T3.AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (T3.AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND T3.AdmLName3 = 'Atoian')
